acceptance: Unit tests: window open + guarded path + no label = fail; window open + `release-fix` label = pass; window closed = pass; non-guarded path = pass

Window tests: 'rc tag exists, final on PyPI' = closed; 'abandoned rc superseded by a higher-version tag' = closed; 'final published by another workflow' = closed; derived from tags and PyPI/release-v2 results, with no manual state file
Stale-status test: on an rc tag push or release-v2 completion, open PRs touching guarded paths get a failing `hold` within 10 minutes (test plus a live demo with a simulated tag or dispatch)
Live check on a throwaway PR during a simulated window shows the hold message naming the open rc and the label to apply
The ADR G13 entry (rv2r-01) names this check
context: Member of batch release-v2-remediation. Prior art: the required `hold` context and the no-auto-merge flow (docs/agent/merge-authority.md). The `release-fix` label is owner-only by policy (MERGE-AUTHORITY-001); agents share the owner account (ADR D4), so this is enforced by discipline and audit, not permissions: agents never apply it. DECISION GATE: changes to required-check settings or label permissions are owner actions; prepare the exact settings change and ask.
description: Owner decision 2026-11-05 (ADR G13): no infrastructure, oracle or CI-machinery merges between an rc tag and its PyPI publish. During 0.5.0, #3942 (oracle cutover) merged mid-release and blocked every PR for about 6 h. Enforce the rule mechanically by extending the existing required `hold` check (pr-hold.yml) rather than adding a new required context. A release window is open when an rc tag vX.Y.ZrcN exists and vX.Y.Z is not yet on PyPI. It closes when vX.Y.Z is on PyPI (published by any workflow), or when a newer rc or final tag of a higher version exists. While a window is open, PRs touching .github/, release and oracle tooling under scripts/, Makefile, tests/uat/, tests/utilities/, docker/ or uv.lock fail `hold` unless they carry the `release-fix` label. Because pr-hold runs only on PR events, a workflow triggered on `push: tags: ['v*rc*']` and on release-v2 completion re-runs each affected open PR's latest pr-hold run (`gh run rerun`). The window state is read live at run time, never from the event payload. Rollback: revert this member's commits; `hold` returns to its current behaviour.
